d: We are looking for a dedicated and presentable Customer Coordination Executive to conduct property demonstrations at the company's completed and handed-over developments.

The successful candidate will be responsible for welcoming real estate brokers and prospective clients visiting our properties, conducting guided tours, and showcasing the quality of construction, apartment finishes, amenities, facilities, and overall development standards.
This role is focused exclusively on property demonstrations and customer experience.
q: Previous experience in real estate, hospitality, customer service is preferred.
Well-presented, confident, and comfortable interacting with brokers and prospective property buyers.
Good knowledge of property terminology, apartment specifications, and building facilities.
Ability to conduct professional property presentations and guided tours.
r: Conduct scheduled property viewings for real estate brokers and their prospective clients at the company's completed developments.
Welcome brokers and clients upon arrival and provide a professional introduction to the property.
Conduct guided tours of apartments, common areas, amenities, and facilities.
Showcase the quality of construction, materials, interior finishes, fittings, fixtures, and overall workmanship.
Explain the property's key features, specifications, and facilities to visitors.
Coordinate with the internal sales team to manage and accommodate scheduled property viewings.
Receive viewing requests and schedules from the respective sales team members.
Coordinate with the sales team and ensure visitors are directed to the correct site location and arrive at the agreed time.
Communicate any viewing-related feedback or issues to the concerned sales team member.
Maintain a professional, welcoming, and informative approach when interacting with brokers and prospective buyers.
Represent the company and its developments positively at all times.
Ensure visitors have a clear understanding of the property's quality and standards.
Address general property-related questions within the scope of the information provided by the company.
Refer all enquiries relating to pricing, availability, payment plans, offers, negotiations, and sales to the respective sales team.
Report any maintenance issues, damages, or concerns identified during property visits.
Maintain a record of completed viewings, including broker details, visitor information, and viewing dates.
Share relevant feedback received from brokers and prospective clients with the sales team.
